item.text: {"classifications":[{"segment_id":"1","code":1,"rationale":"The President immediately delegates an executive function to the OPM Director; this is an internal assignment of authority, not a substantive determination of legal rights or a dictated later legal outcome.","evidence":"I hereby delegate to the Director of the Office of Personnel Management (OPM) the authority vested in the President"},{"segment_id":"2","code":1,"rationale":"The OPM Director must account for executive agencies’ mission needs when later issuing rules, regulations, and guidelines, but the segment does not dictate a specific legally consequential result.","evidence":"shall ensure that rules, regulations, and guidelines issued in the exercise of such authority take appropriate account of the needs of executive agencies"},{"segment_id":"3","code":1,"rationale":"The OPM Director must consult specified and discretionary executive-branch officers while exercising the delegated authority; this is an internal procedural requirement without an independently prescribed legal consequence.","evidence":"The Director shall consult the Attorney General and such other officers of the executive branch"}]}
